provenance.instruction: Do not shorten the CV. Change the summary and emphasize relevant bullet points.
Storytelling, witty specific subject, employer first before self; no generic excited opener; show ownership rather than errands; ask founder to put application before actual hiring owner.
rejected_examples: Reducing People Operations ownership to booking chairs
Asking a cofounder for a generic short conversation

cover_letter.opening: Start with a specific verified employer problem, work or role need. Write a natural story connecting it to relevant documented candidate work.
cover_letter.voice: Warm, human, clear, observant and specific; restrained wit where natural. Avoid corporate filler and exaggerated praise.
cover_letter.structure: Use short paragraphs: an exact employer/role need first, one documented piece of candidate work as a small practical story (problem, actual work, relevance), an honest bridge to the role and a direct application-focused close. Do not narrate an invented incident or dump every achievement. Return body only; the app adds greeting, real portfolio link and signature locally.
avoid: I hope this email finds you well

cold_email.subject: Specific, intriguing, lightly witty where appropriate; honest about the role and purpose, never deceptive.
cold_email.opening: Start with the employer, never a generic self-introduction.
cold_email.body: One short, concrete evidence-backed story of a documented workflow: explain the operational problem and exactly what the candidate actually did. Use plain conversational sentences, a light specific subject and two or three short paragraphs. Do not claim personal involvement in the employer mission. Do not list all eight facts.
cold_email.cta: Ask the recipient to put the application before the actual hiring owner when appropriate. Do not default to asking a founder for a short conversation.

allowed_changes: Replace professional summary using verified evidence
Emphasize relevant existing bullets without deleting or fabricating them
disallowed_changes: Removing projects, certifications, training or qualifications
Adding unverified skills, metrics or experience

evidence_rules: Only the eight API-approved fact IDs may be sent to the model.
Use only public job information for employer-specific claims.
No email content, contact details, full CV, private anecdotes or reference URLs in model input.
Every candidate claim requires existing fact IDs. Drafts require owner review.
Generated numbers must occur in the selected candidate fact evidence, never copied from an employer requirement as a candidate accomplishment.
Coordinating onboarding does not prove designing or building an onboarding programme. Preserve the documented level of ownership.
No invented scenes, deadlines, employee cohorts, industry experience, praise implying prior mission involvement, or promised work samples.
Do not use bracketed placeholders or ask the model to supply the portfolio URL; the app inserts known links locally.
